lines.t: [Catchy viral beat]
I came with my hands full of questions
And a heart that forgot how to rest
You met me inside of the struggle
You called me to give You my best
Not with the pride of a ruler
Not with the need to be seen
But with a life that is willing
To become what You made me to be
Teach me to serve before demanding
Teach me to listen when I hurt
Make my hands open toward my neighbor
Make my heart put others first
You know me fully, You know my name
You see the tears that I cannot explain
You are not finished, You stay near
Teaching my heart how to persevere
So I will trust You through every day
Choosing Your goodness along the way
With humble hands and a heart made new
I will keep walking, Lord, with You
When I remember the failures
And all of the things I regret
You tell me to come with repentance
Your mercy is with me yet
You see the heart under sorrow
You see the work still undone
You call me Your precious creation
A child who is learning to love
Teach me to serve before demanding
Teach me to listen when I hurt
Make my hands open toward my neighbor
Make my heart put others first
You know me fully, You know my name
You see the tears that I cannot explain
You are not finished, You stay near
Teaching my heart how to persevere
So I will trust You through every day
Choosing Your goodness along the way
With humble hands and a heart made new
I will keep walking, Lord, with You
I am more than my worst moment
More than every wrong I made
You know the heart beneath the struggle
You are patient while I change
So I will walk in humble patience
I will choose the good today
I will love the one before me
And keep going in Your way
Oh, make me faithful
Oh, make me kind
Teach me obedience
Renew my mind
Oh, make me faithful
In all I do
A servant of mercy
Belonging to You
You know me fully, You know my name
You see the tears that I cannot explain
You are not finished, You stay near
Teaching my heart how to persevere
So I will trust You through every day
Choosing Your goodness along the way
With humble hands and a heart made new
I will keep walking, Lord, with You
Still here in the waiting
Still here in the pain
Still here in the questions
Still here the same
